# App-by-action coverage

<!-- Generated by scripts/coverage-doc.mjs from contracts/coverage/matrix.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

This page lists what Zekvar Browser protects in each supported AI app, by user action and enforcement mode. The source of truth is `contracts/coverage/matrix.json`. A Browser test (`apps/browser-extension/test/coverage-matrix.test.mjs`) fails if a supported or experimental cell names a test that does not exist, or if this page is out of date.

## Evidence status

- **Controlled-fixture evidence** exists for every supported and experimental cell. Fixtures are local pages shaped like each app, served at the real app origin inside an isolated Chrome profile. They prove Browser behavior against the layouts the fixtures copy, not against the current production sites.
- **Live signed-out evidence** is optional and limited to the public ChatGPT and Gemini pages. It runs only with `node scripts/verify-demo.mjs --live`, and its results are not recorded in this repository.
- **Live signed-in evidence does not exist yet.** No cell has been verified in a signed-in customer workspace. Treat every cell as unverified on signed-in production layouts until that evidence is recorded.

## Status definitions

- **Supported**: On by default for the app and proven by a named controlled-fixture connected test for this app, action, and mode.
- **Experimental**: Implemented, but the app is opt-in or the named tests prove this mode through a sibling app, a shared engine unit test, or a different mode.
- **Unsupported**: Not implemented. Browser does not intercept or offer this mode.

Versions are the minimum Zekvar Browser release that ships the behavior. Modes that an action does not offer are Unsupported. File and intake actions offer Monitor and Block only. Redact is an employee action available when a prompt is warned or blocked.

### ChatGPT evidence

- Typed prompt sent with the Send control:
  - Controlled fixture (Monitor): restores Monitor and delivers a queued event exactly once after a lost acknowledgment
  - Controlled fixture (Warn): allows one ChatGPT warning override for the unchanged draft
  - Controlled fixture (Warn): previews and enforces different prompt modes in three composers and preserves clipboard policy
  - Controlled fixture (Block): guards click and Enter on the supported ChatGPT-shaped composer and sends edited text
  - Controlled fixture (Block): publishes Block, verifies Chrome applied it, and shows Send and Enter decisions in Control
  - Live signed-out (Block): live public ChatGPT in the same fresh profile
  - Controlled fixture (Redact): redacts a blocked multiline editor draft as one recoverable edit and requires a separate send
  - Controlled fixture (Redact): redacts a warned guest textarea draft and invalidates stale draft and policy actions
- Typed prompt sent with Enter:
  - Controlled fixture (Monitor): restores Monitor and delivers a queued event exactly once after a lost acknowledgment
  - Controlled fixture (Monitor, Block): guards click and Enter on the supported ChatGPT-shaped composer and sends edited text
  - Controlled fixture (Warn): allows one ChatGPT warning override for the unchanged draft
  - Controlled fixture (Block): publishes Block, verifies Chrome applied it, and shows Send and Enter decisions in Control
  - Live signed-out (Block): live public ChatGPT in the same fresh profile
  - Controlled fixture (Redact): redacts a blocked multiline editor draft as one recoverable edit and requires a separate send
- Native text paste into the composer:
  - Controlled fixture (Monitor, Block): guards native text paste before it reaches supported AI composers and reports only decision metadata
- Native file picker selection:
  - Controlled fixture (Monitor): applies per-app controls to native picker, drop, and clipboard file events
  - Controlled fixture (Monitor): protects attachments through native Chrome intake and Control reporting
  - Controlled fixture (Block): releases scanned snapshots and keeps sensitive, unsupported, and stale selections from the site
- Native file drag and drop:
  - Controlled fixture (Monitor): applies per-app controls to native picker, drop, and clipboard file events
  - Controlled fixture (Monitor): protects attachments through native Chrome intake and Control reporting
  - Controlled fixture (Block): releases scanned snapshots and keeps sensitive, unsupported, and stale selections from the site
  - Live signed-out (Block): holds matching native file drops on live signed-out ChatGPT and Gemini and reports their methods
- Clipboard file or image paste:
  - Controlled fixture (Monitor): applies per-app controls to native picker, drop, and clipboard file events
  - Controlled fixture (Block): releases scanned snapshots and keeps sensitive, unsupported, and stale selections from the site
- Plain text attachment content:
  - Unit (Monitor): reads UTF-8 bytes independently of upload names and declared media types
  - Controlled fixture (Monitor, Block): releases scanned snapshots and keeps sensitive, unsupported, and stale selections from the site
- Office Open XML attachment (Word, Excel, PowerPoint):
  - Controlled fixture (Monitor): protects attachments through native Chrome intake and Control reporting
  - Unit (Monitor): recognizes Word, Excel, and PowerPoint by bytes and combines formatted text runs
  - Controlled fixture (Block): releases scanned snapshots and keeps sensitive, unsupported, and stale selections from the site
- OpenDocument attachment (text, spreadsheet, presentation):
  - Controlled fixture (Monitor, Block): monitors and blocks OpenDocument intake and releases clean document bytes
  - Unit (Monitor): reads OpenDocument formatted text, cell values, notes, and style text by package bytes
- PDF with selectable text:
  - Controlled fixture (Monitor, Block): scans PDF page text locally and blocks incomplete checks before native attachments reach the site
- Scanned or mixed PDF pages (local OCR):
  - Controlled fixture (Monitor, Block): recognizes scanned PDF pages even when the document also contains selectable text
- PNG or JPEG image text (local OCR):
  - Controlled fixture (Monitor, Block): recognizes English image text from bundled OCR and holds unclear or malformed images

## Administrator adapter controls

Control can disable one app adapter, or only its attachment intake, for the baseline or a rollout group. Browser reports a disabled adapter as **Disabled by administrator**, not Unsupported. Fail closed reuses the AI app access host block. See the broken-adapter runbook in `docs/support-and-incident-response.md`.

| AI app | Control | Fallback | Status |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ChatGPT | Disable attachments | Fail open | Supported · v0.42.0 |
| ChatGPT | Disable attachments | Fail closed | Supported · v0.42.0 |
| ChatGPT | Disable the whole adapter | Fail open | Supported · v0.42.0 |
| ChatGPT | Disable the whole adapter | Fail closed | Supported · v0.42.0 |
| Gemini | Disable attachments | Fail open | Experimental · v0.42.0 |
| Gemini | Disable attachments | Fail closed | Experimental · v0.42.0 |
| Gemini | Disable the whole adapter | Fail open | Experimental · v0.42.0 |
| Gemini | Disable the whole adapter | Fail closed | Experimental · v0.42.0 |
| Claude | Disable attachments | Fail open | Experimental · v0.42.0 |
| Claude | Disable attachments | Fail closed | Experimental · v0.42.0 |
| Claude | Disable the whole adapter | Fail open | Experimental · v0.42.0 |
| Claude | Disable the whole adapter | Fail closed | Experimental · v0.42.0 |
